desc: Michael sips coffee at his cluttered desk, a globe and colorful fuzzy ball nearby.
Angry-looking Dwight with a trench coat on walks out of a building beside Ryan.
Dwight turns and smiles at Ryan while driving past fields.
A marina full of docked boats sits below a tall brown glass-paneled building on the left.
Jim in a blue shirt rolls backward on his office chair toward the photocopier.
A wide shot from far away shows two men by a car surrounded by a green field, near farmland.
Dwight opens and closes his hand while Ryan reaches in and takes something from it in a field.
Stanley suddenly stands up from his desk, grabs a crossword puzzle under his arm, and runs out.
Michael steps out of the elevator, sees a huge line of people, and looks disappointed.
A shot of a baked good being prepared: sprinkled with toppings, then placed into the oven to bake.
A crowded hallway with a line of bored employees, one yawning.
Ryan in a suit kneels in dirt planting something.
A car speeds away kicking up dust, leaving Ryan in a suit behind in the field.
Stanley stands in a long line laughing joyfully.
Stanley waves his hand in disagreement, outraged, pointing back toward the end of the line.
Ryan, in a suit, walks across a field toward a wooden barn.
Man in the suit knocks on the wooden door.
Dwight throws his arms up shouting excitedly outside a wooden barn.
Jim works at his computer while a woman in blue blazer beside him swaying back and forth in her chair.
Andy at the front sits at his desk, moving a pen up and down while looking down, coworkers behind him.
Michael stands hunched forward, pinching the bridge of his nose in frustration while Pam steps out of the elevator.
A wide shot of dusty barn filled with straw and scattered farm equipment.
Ryan sits slumped in a chair, Dwight stands behind him, a third man rushes past behind.
Dwight leans in close, his mouth near the head of seated Ryan in the wheelchair.
Dwight opens a coffin lid, standing beside it in dim barn.
Ryan walks through tall grass as a red car slows alongside.
Andy in a blue checkered shirt and green tie at the front looks furious, while Jim works at a computer behind him.
Ryan grab eggs from a straw basket on the car seat.
Dwight and Ryan throw something at a white building, then flee back to the red car.
Two security guards walk out of a building, one with his arms spread out.
A parking sign splattered with dripping yellow egg.
Dwight and Ryan sit at a bar chugging their beers while one chokes.
Ryan chugging a beer while Dwight slaps his palms on the table, then pounds his fists.
